entries.land_description: Blueberry Cove, mid-coast Maine at its best, is a woman-owned, women-run alternative vacation space for people concerned with human growth, spiritual awareness and love of the earth. Meadows, spruce woods overlook the harbor with our own wharf and boats. Guests eat (vegetarian) and congregate in the "Maine" lodge, and sleep in small cabins or tent along the shore. Workshops, many for women only, include topics such as sailing, building, inner work. We have: woods, camping space.

(located in Huntington Ctr near Burlington, VT). HOWL is a group of women, primarily lesbian, who have been working together for almost three years to raise $150,000 to buy land for a living and camping space land trust. We lease 190+ acres of woods and fields now, which we camp on in the summer. Primitive camping, $3-$8/nite (bring water, food, tents, etc). Hiking, peace, outdoor work and play. Beautiful Vermont mountain-side. We are/have: 20 lesbians, 3 nonlesbians, 100 acres, woods, farmland, camping space.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl children, young boy children, nonlesbian women

entries.land_description: Greenhope is a Woman's Guest House (going into our sixth year) and farm. We operate a small commercial goat dairy, make cheese, yogurt, also produce maple syrup. We have five horses and offer guided trail rides for a fee. We have six guest rooms, with breakfast and vegetarian dinners. There is no smoking in the house. Rooms average $40/night for two including breakfast. Special weekly rates in summer. Open year round. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, accessible, woods, farmland, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, males with women

entries.land_description: Feminist Vegetarian Retreat, the Inn at Bloodroot, a B & B for women (girl children only) on the water near Long Island Sound. Large old house with private and shared bath accommodations, next door to Bloodroot Feminist Vegetarian Restaurant and Bookstore. Open year round. No minimum stay. Non-smoking. Accessible by public transportation.

entries.community_name: K'SAAN - A PLACE OF RETREAT FOR WOMEN
entries.land_description: (located in Milford, PA). K'saan is a place where lesbians can get to know themselves better, and can be themselves in a setting that welcomes them. While it is not a formal religious retreat house, K'saan is a place of spirituality - a place where women's spirits can roam free and soar, a place to relax, read, and reflect. K'saan, built in 1984, is situated on 45 acres of forest and marshland. Old stone fences and woodland trails criss-cross the property. Enjoy swimming or a time for quiet reflection by the pond. We are/have: 45 acres, woods.

(located near NYS Thruway exit 20). The Wise Woman Center is home, sacred space, hospitable haven, and a delightful classroom filled with capricious goats, funny fairies, and wild weeds. It exists to help reweave the Wise Woman's dancing cape. Hers is an old dance: powerful, beautiful, and ever-changing. And we are the threads of her cape. Gathering in our circles we spin new yarns; shuttling back and forth we are woven strong. The Goddess lives at the Wise Woman Center, growing Green Witches in her garden guarded by the elder bush. Most workshops and playshops held here are open to men and women. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 1 nonlesbian, 50 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Most workshops and playshops held here are open to men and women.

entries.street_address: c/o Pat McCarrick and Greta Moran, RD 1 Box 67
entries.land_description: Pat and Greta's cedar-sided guesthouse is located in the heart of the four season recreational Pocono Mtns of PA. Situated on eight private wooded acres, the house features a magnificent view of the Delaware Water Gap. Rooms are tastefully decorated in different motifs. Each morning a complimentary buffet country breakfast is served, and cooking is permitted in our kitchen. Many guests enjoy hiking, canoeing, antiquing, and skiing or just relaxing on the deck or in the outdoor hot tub. A fully-stocked VCR room is also available for your enjoyment. Blueberry Ridge offers lesbians a peaceful, comfortable, romantic atmosphere. Most holidays are made special occasions to be remembered.

A simple bed & breakfast for traveling women in Washington, DC. Close to Metro and amenities. Not fancy, just clean and affordable. Light continental breakfast of tea, coffee, fruit or fruit juice and rolls or pastry. Parking very limited, no smoking in common areas, 2 week maximum.

(one hour from Asheville, NC, two hours from Atlanta). Bed and breakfast on a mountaintop. Spend a weekend or a vacation on eight acres of privacy; rhododendron, mountain laurel, dogwoods, oaks and pines abound.
